description: GRU (arm R) and E2E-SO (arm T-E2E-SO-lo) trained on the same training episodes and read on the same evaluation episodes (hold_N, hold_X, hold_S, 150 each), original training seeds 0, 1, 2, final checkpoints (20000 steps). These are the evaluation sets of the training run, not the fresh-episode sets of original_seeds_fresh_episodes_summary.json.
metric: AUROC of the imagined lift beyond the window, query delays L = 12, 24, 48 pooled; chance .5. Lists are per seed 0, 1, 2; *_mean is their unweighted mean.
timing: s_per_step: seconds per training step for one process, measured over 20 calibration steps on one RTX 4090.
